description: Previews explicit completed jobs for review requests, including eligibility and skip reasons, without sending anything. Use to preview review requests in the connected business. Returns requested, eligible, skipped, destination_configured, default_channel, items, sent, scope.
name: preview-review-requests

default_channel.description: Default channel used or returned by this tool.

destination_configured.description: Whether the review destination is configured.

items.description: Bounded items records returned by this tool.

scope.description: Authorization scope of this result; data remains restricted to the connected business.

sent.description: Sent flag; previews do not perform this action.

title: Preview Review Requests Tool
